svg.aria-label: The four package layers in dependency order
svg.text: roles, storefronts, buyers, deployed services: where domains define market behavior through composition
what a family or domain supplies to be composed: vocabulary, contracts, clients, codecs, policies, adapters, family kits
reusable capabilities that compose nothing and discover nothing
A package depends only on its own layer or a lower one, and dependencies within one layer are acyclic. Any import is a dependency, including one under TYPE_CHECKING or behind try/except.
